"""A/B/C latency of POST /api/search on parquet in one process (#127 review): reliability shadow
B — off (no reliability at all), A — this branch (the shown page only), C — the old way (every candidate)."""
import json, os, sys
from src.eval import latency
from src.match import pipeline, search as search_mod
from src.api import app as app_mod
app_mod._queue_uncached = lambda page, uncached: None  # no writes to the neighbour's Postgres queue

n = int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 200
orig_with, orig_pick = pipeline.with_reliability, pipeline.pick
out = {}
def load():
    return open('/proc/loadavg').read().split()[:3]

def off(matches, as_of):
    return matches

def pick_all(query, **kw):
    res = orig_pick(query, **kw)
    res.matches = search_mod.shadow_reliability(res.matches, query.as_of)
    return res

for label in ("B-off", "A-page", "C-all"):
    pipeline.with_reliability = off if label != "A-page" else orig_with
    pipeline.pick = pick_all if label == "C-all" else orig_pick
    l0 = load()
    r = latency.measure(n)
    out[label] = {"latency_ms": r["latency_ms"], "n_queries": r["n_queries"], "store": r["store"],
                  "load_before": l0, "load_after": load()}
    print(label, out[label], flush=True)
print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
